newsitem.title: UK: Ford Motor Credit sets 3.0 bln FRF bond.
newsitem.headline: Ford Motor Credit sets 3.0 bln FRF bond.

text.p: Ford Motor Credit has launched a
3.0 billion French franc two-tranche bond via joint lead
managers BNP and SocGen.
Each tranche is for 1.5 billion French francs and has a
euro-fungible clause.
